explanation: Sort each team by height and compare players at equal ranks. A strict increase at every rank gives a valid front/back placement; a failed rank cannot be repaired by a different matching. The method checks the requested direction only, and the judge calls it for both directions.
spaceComplexity: O(n) auxiliary space for sorted copies.
